cowardice_flags.avoided: The analysis's own source_notes admit the Thai army's July 2026 line about 'any country that provides hiding places' was left off the cards 'because the only country it can refer to is Malaysia and the card would have to say so.' The mature card then says 'a foreign hand is an alibi for every domestic one' without naming the foreign hand that is actually on the Thai official record.
cowardice_flags.should_say: Thai commanders after the 22 July 2026 Ra-ngae attack vowed to hunt the killers 'regardless of who is helping whom or which country is providing assistance.' Bangkok Post and Thai PBS recorded the NSC secretary-general saying Malaysia holds the key to peace because BRN figures have long used Kelantan as a second home, often via dual-citizenship and the Golok border. That is the documented 'foreign hand' on the Thai record. Israel is not. The rumour works by fusing Anwar's Mossad line, Sondhi's tourist-Mossad line, and this unspoken Malaysia line into one imported villain.

cowardice_flags.avoided: The hook states as a lead fact that 'Sondhi Limthongkul told Israel's ambassador on 10 September that Mossad personnel are scattered across Thailand.' The analysis itself marks this as medium confidence: Thai Examiner paraphrase, Bangkok Post text blocked.
cowardice_flags.should_say: Sondhi submitted an open letter on tourist conduct, nominee land, Chabad centres and Gaza. Thai Examiner paraphrases him as also claiming Mossad personnel are scattered and calling some visitors 'warriors in tourist disguise.' Bangkok Post, The Nation and Khaosod summaries of the same rally do not quote that Mossad sentence from the letter. An honest hook would attribute the Mossad wording to one outlet's paraphrase, not present it as the event.

false_balance.where: Mature card and reframe: treating every 'foreign hand' as equally fictional so the Deep South 'needs no imported villain.'
false_balance.evidence_says: Absence of Israel/Mossad on the Deep South record is well supported. Equating that absence with the Malaysia sanctuary file is not. After 22 July 2026, Army Chief of Staff Gen Chaiyapruek said perpetrators would be hunted 'no matter which country is protecting them'; Foreign Minister Sihasak said Thailand would ask Malaysia to deny safe haven; Kelantan police chief Mohd Yusoff replied that Malaysia wanted proof and had not been given it. That is a live interstate dispute, not a rumour with zero official footprint.

audience_check: A taxi driver in Ipoh and a teacher in Kota Bharu would recognise the dated court cases and Anwar's Dewan Rakyat line. They would not share the electrician-dog analogy. Kelantan and northern Perak live next to Golok; the local gossip is sanctuary, dual MyKad, cigarette runs and BRN facilitators, not Pai Chabad. The piece speaks English-policy to people who already distrust imported-villain talk, and lectures past the border Malaysians who actually sit inside the rumour's real geography. A hawker in Penang might forward the 5,999-dead number. A farmer in Sabah would shrug: another peninsula morality play that will not name the neighbour.

hard_truths_missing.about: Malay community (social and political, not just UMNO/PAS)
hard_truths_missing.truth: Palestine functions as a moral master-key. Once a Malay-Muslim prime minister tells the Dewan Rakyat that Mossad 'has a presence here' because of Malaysia's Palestine stance, large parts of Malay social media will attach Israel to the next explosion in a Malay-speaking province of Thailand whether or not any record exists. Ethnic kinship with Patani Malays does the rest. This does not require jihadist conversion; Crisis Group already found the insurgency is nationalist. It requires a reflex that treats Israel as the only foreign hand worth naming and Malaysia as the one that must not be named.
hard_truths_missing.why_avoided: Naming the reflex sounds like blaming ordinary Malays for a Thai war. The analysis chose institutional dates over audience psychology.

hard_truths_missing.truth: Anwar used the Avitan/Selangor-couple case in the Dewan Rakyat on 22 July 2025 as evidence that Palestine virtue attracts Mossad. The PN MP who asked the question wanted that answer. Both sides farm the same symbol. Neither side then told the public that the same week's Thai record pointed at Malaysia, not Tel Aviv, as the sanctuary problem.
hard_truths_missing.why_avoided: Attacking only 'the rumour' lets every Malaysian party keep the Mossad applause line.

hard_truths_missing.about: Islam in Malaysia (faith vs political Islam)
hard_truths_missing.truth: BRN's October 2023 'Patani-Palestine: Unite' clip is ethno-nationalist analogising: colonised Patani, colonised Palestine, merdeka. Crisis Group 2017 found no evidence of jihadist inroads precisely because the fronts are nationalists who fear ISIS would destroy local support and invite foreign intervention. Malaysian political Islam routinely collapses that distinction and reads every southern Thai blast through Gaza. The analysis quotes both sources and then refuses to say the collapse is the rumour's engine.
hard_truths_missing.why_avoided: Separating Malay-Muslim nationalism from political-Islam branding is treated as sectarian.

hard_truths_missing.truth: Not the rumour's engine. Thai-Chinese capital and tourism anxiety (Pai, Phuket, nominee land) feed Sondhi's Bangkok street politics, which then gets laundered into Malay online talk as 'Zionist takeover' and finally glued onto Narathiwat. The analysis lists Pai and nominee probes as Israel-on-Thailand-record without saying the Deep South rumour is a second-order import of a central-Thai culture war.
hard_truths_missing.why_avoided: Would require a class/region map the cards refuse to draw.

hard_truths_missing.truth: Marginal to this file. No caste or temple fact is required to explain the rumour. Forcing one would be the overclaim the brief forbids.
Not material to the Israel-Deep South rumour. Thai royal-nationalist street politics (Sondhi's yellow-shirt lineage) is relevant to the Bangkok protest, not to Narathiwat command.

gender_truths_avoided.truth: The Deep South body count is male-heavy among both militants and Thai security forces (SBPAC: 2,338 of 5,999 certified dead are state personnel, overwhelmingly men). The 22 July 2026 dead were five male rangers. October 7 Thai dead were male agricultural workers. Women and children appear as civilian wounded and as the community that must live under cordon-and-search. The rumour debate is staged as a male contest of villains (Mossad, BRN, army) and never asks who actually buries the sons.
gender_truths_avoided.why_uncomfortable: Gendering a 'security' story is treated as a Western import.

class_truths_avoided.truth: 340.7 billion baht under southern-border operational plans FY2004–FY2026 is not only 'security spending.' It is a standing payroll and allowance economy. Prachatai's budget reporting records ISOC personnel costs in the billions of baht a year and public suspicion of ghost posts. Norathip's own account of the August wave ties attacks to an 18.7 million baht cash seizure and cigarette networks 'these networks cannot survive without money.' Illicit trade across Golok funds gunmen and enriches a border class on both sides. Racialising the rumour as Israel-versus-Islam hides a smuggling and patronage machine that has outlived every government.
class_truths_avoided.why_uncomfortable: It implicates Thai security budgets and Malaysian border commerce, not a distant intelligence service.

predictions.if_nothing_changes: Within 48 hours of the next multi-district Deep South wave, Malay-language social media will again name Mossad or Israel. Thai spokesmen will again speak of 'any country' and 'safe haven' without putting Malaysia in the sentence. Anwar will not issue a correction tying his 2025 Mossad remark to the Deep South, because the remark was never about the Deep South and the applause line still works.
predictions.who_can_fix: Anwar (stop letting a Klang Valley gun case stand in for a Patani war); Thai Fourth Army and MFA (name the sanctuary claim and produce the evidence Malaysia asked for); Malaysian Home Ministry and Kelantan police (answer the dual-citizenship and facilitator file instead of asking for proof they know is politically radioactive).
predictions.why_they_wont: Anwar's Palestine stance is domestic capital. Thai cabinets need Malaysian facilitation of BRN talks more than they need a public row. Kelantan politics cannot be seen to hunt 'our people' for Bangkok.
predictions.label: HYPOTHESIS

cardinal_sin_flags.in_my_attack: Stating as established fact that Malaysia officially shelters BRN fighters.
cardinal_sin_flags.why_I_dropped_it: Thai officials allege; Kelantan police say no evidence has been handed over. The harder truth that stands is the allegation-and-evasion pattern, not a proven sanctuary verdict.

cardinal_sin_flags.in_my_attack: Repeating 'Mossad personnel are scattered across Thailand' as Sondhi's letter text.
cardinal_sin_flags.why_I_dropped_it: Only Thai Examiner paraphrases that sentence. Using it as Sondhi's verified wording would commit the same sin the hook commits.

cardinal_sin_flags.in_my_attack: Asserting Meta's 2019/2022/2024 reports contain zero Thailand-adjacent activity of any kind.
cardinal_sin_flags.why_I_dropped_it: The analysis searched those reports for the word Thailand and found none in the Israel-influence sections. I did not re-open the PDFs. The safer claim is the analysis's own: the word is absent from the cited reports.

verification_log.my_attack: Thai officials after 22 July 2026 pointed at a neighbouring country as possible hiding place and later asked Malaysia to deny safe haven.
The analysis deliberately omitted that line so it would not have to name Malaysia.
verification_log.primary_source: analysis source_notes in the supplied file

verification_log.my_attack: Anwar told the Dewan Rakyat on 22 July 2025 that Mossad has a presence in Malaysia and cited a Selangor couple smuggling weapons from Thailand.
Sondhi's 10 September 2026 rally letter is reported by Bangkok Post as tourist conduct, Chabad, land and Gaza; the Mossad-scattered wording is Thai Examiner's paraphrase.
Crisis Group Asia Report 291 found no evidence of jihadist inroads as of 2017 because the fronts are nationalists.
SBPAC certified 5,999 deaths to 26 Dec 2025; parliamentary data give 340,706.76 million baht under principal southern-border plans FY2004–FY2026.
Mae Hong Son tourist police said about 83–84 Israelis a day in Pai, not 30,000 settlers.
Thai court 22 Aug 2013: Moradi life, Khazaei 15 years, plot described by Gen Prewpan as aimed at Israeli diplomatic staff.
Shalom Avitan sentenced 26 Feb 2025 to seven years; police said guns came via a Malaysian couple from Thailand; he claimed a criminal hunt, not a Deep South mission.
BRN Information Department posted a Patani-Palestine solidarity clip on 12 Oct 2023.
Norathip tied the 22 Aug 2026 wave to sweeps and an 18.7 million baht cash seizure: networks cannot survive without money.

Thai-worker death toll on 7 Oct 2023 is contested (Thai MFA 32–33 early; later embassy/Diplomat figures of 41 circulate). The card's unattributed 41 is the analysis's own flagged weakness, not a finding I am adding.

strongest_card.why: The reframe is the only sentence that puts scale on the table: 22 years, 340 billion baht, 5,999 certified dead. That is the electrician's report. It does not need Israel to be true.

weakest_card.why: The hook leads with a medium-confidence paraphrase as if it were the letter, then pairs it with Anwar's 2025 parliamentary claim that does not mention the Deep South. It manufactures a Israel-Thailand-Malaysia triangle the record does not join.

overall_assessment: The analysis wins the narrow fact-check it set itself: nothing on the Thai or Malaysian official or court record puts Israel or Mossad in Narathiwat. That finding should stand. What it will not say, even though it wrote the sentence in its own notes, is that the rumour is a fusion of three real ingredients — Anwar's Mossad applause line, Sondhi's Bangkok culture-war letter, and the Thai army's refusal to name Malaysia — and that the only foreign hand Thai commanders were circling in July 2026 was the neighbour that facilitates the peace talks. Calling every foreign hand an 'alibi' while burying the one that is actually on the record is not discipline. It is the same diplomatic cowardice the cards pretend to attack.
